statements.status_notes: mathjax 2.7.9 is bundled as a static JS asset used by Jupyter's classic notebook and nbclassic extensions for mathematical formula rendering. CVE-2023-39663 describes a ReDoS vulnerability in MathJax's parsing of certain LaTeX inputs. No upstream fix is available for the 2.x branch; the fix targets MathJax 3.x, which is a breaking API change requiring coordinated upstream adoption across the Jupyter ecosystem. The vulnerable rendering code is only reachable when a notebook user supplies crafted LaTeX input via the notebook UI. Investigation is ongoing to assess exposure and to monitor for an upstream 2.x patch or Jupyter's migration to MathJax 3.x.

mathjax 2.7.9 is bundled as a static JS asset used by Jupyter's classic notebook and nbclassic extensions for mathematical formula rendering. CVE-2023-39663 describes a ReDoS vulnerability in MathJax's parsing of certain LaTeX inputs. No upstream fix is available for the 2.x branch; the fix targets MathJax 3.x, which is a breaking API change requiring coordinated upstream adoption across the Jupyter ecosystem. The vulnerable rendering code is only reachable when a notebook user supplies crafted LaTeX input via the notebook UI. Investigation is ongoing to assess exposure and to monitor for an upstream 2.x patch or Jupyter's migration to MathJax 3.x.

mathjax 2.7.9 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/MathJax/. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI; the default user-facing UI in this image is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own (newer) MathJax bundle, not the bundled-with-nbclassic copy. The vulnerable ReDoS regex runs in the user's browser only if the user opts into the classic UI under /tree, and only with input the user themselves controls (math expressions in their own notebook). Upstream Mathjax 2.x is in long-term maintenance and no fix is planned in that line.
